extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager and the store.

extensionDescription.message: Reads web pages aloud with natural-sounding voices on Linux.

commandToggleDescription.message: Read the page aloud or stop

contextMenuReadSelection.description: Context-menu item shown when text is selected.

playerbarLabel.description: Accessibility label of the player toolbar.

playerbarResume.description: Label of the pause button while paused.

engineTooltipCloud.description: Tooltip of the engine indicator when the cloud engine is active.

engineTooltipLocal.description: Tooltip of the engine indicator when the local engine is active.

noticeNoText.message: No readable text found on this page.
noticeNoText.description: Notice shown when the page contains no readable text.

noticeHelperOffline.message: Helper is not running. Install with: pipx install './helper[piper]' (see README)
noticeHelperOffline.description: Notice shown when the local helper cannot be reached.

noticeReadFailed.description: Notice shown when playback fails; $1 is the error message.

viewerLoading.description: Status text in the PDF viewer while the document loads.

viewerLoadingPage.description: Status text in the PDF viewer while pages render; $1 is the current page, $2 the total.

viewerLoadFailed.description: Status text in the PDF viewer when loading fails; $1 is the error message.

viewerNoText.message: No text found in this PDF (scanned document?).
viewerNoText.description: Status text when the PDF has no text layer (OCR is not supported).

viewerNoSrc.description: Status text when the viewer is opened without a src parameter.

optionsHeading.description: Main heading of the options page.

optionsRateLabel.description: Label of the default-speed dropdown on the options page.

optionsVoicesLegend.description: Legend of the voices fieldset on the options page.

optionsEngineLegend.description: Legend of the engine fieldset on the options page.

optionsEngineCloud.description: Label of the cloud engine radio button.

optionsEngineLocal.description: Label of the local engine radio button.

optionsEngineLocalFirst.description: Label of the local-first engine radio button.

optionsPrivacyNote.message: With cloud (Edge), the text being read is sent to Microsoft via the local helper; with local (Piper), the text stays entirely on your computer.
optionsPrivacyNote.description: Privacy note below the engine choice.

optionsHelperLoading.description: Placeholder while the helper status is being fetched.

optionsSaved.description: Confirmation shown after a setting is saved.

optionsHelperReachable.description: Helper status when the helper responds but the voice count is unknown.

optionsHelperReachableVoices.description: Helper status with the number of installed Piper voices; $1 is the count.

optionsHelperUnreachable.message: Helper: unreachable (is the local helper running?)
optionsHelperUnreachable.description: Helper status when the helper cannot be reached.

langNl.description: Name of the Dutch language in the voice list.

langEn.description: Name of the English language in the voice list.

langDe.description: Name of the German language in the voice list.

langFr.description: Name of the French language in the voice list.

langEs.description: Name of the Spanish language in the voice list.
